# AnyCode

> User documentation for configuring and using AnyCode coding sessions.

Start with the documentation map, then follow the matching task or symptom.
Check the session's engine and installed version before applying instructions.

## User guide

- [Documentation map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/README.md): Start here for task and symptom navigation.
- [Project instruction snippet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/AGENTS-SNIPPET.md): Copy setup and secret-handling instructions into AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/getting-started.md): Connect a project, review trust, use session controls, rewind and compact context.
- [Providers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/providers.md): Configure connections, effort, images, quotas and setup export or import.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/configuration.md): Distinguish app settings, shared config, merge rules and environment overrides.
- [Engines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/engines.md): Set up Native, Codex and Claude engines, binaries and accounts.
- [Permissions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/permissions.md): Choose modes, approval rules, classifiers and engine presets.
- [Orchestration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/orchestration.md): Use Orchestrate mode or a manual supervisor workflow.
- [Roles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/roles.md): Configure role routes, fallbacks, profiles and parallel child limits.
- [Subagents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/subagents.md): Define profiles, delegate to child sessions and inspect their outcomes.
- [Skills](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/skills.md): Create, import, disable and verify skills, or install external setup help.
- [Hooks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/hooks.md): Configure commands for prompt, tool and stop events.
- [Workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/workflows.md): Define bounded sequences of dependent subagent steps.
- [Worktrees](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/worktrees.md): Enter, leave and recover changes from isolated git checkouts.
- [MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/mcp.md): Add or import MCP servers, manage trust and verify connections.
- [Language servers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/lsp.md): Configure language servers and diagnostics after file edits.
- [Plugins](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/plugins.md): Install plugins and understand contributions, trust and account sources.
- [Browser](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/browser.md): Operate the preview with browser tools and understand access boundaries.
- [Proxy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/proxy.md): Configure network profiles and per-connection proxy routing.
- [Sessions API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/sessions-api.md): Share live sessions and communicate through the local API or MCP adapter.
- [Remote control](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/remote-control.md): Control shared sessions and approvals through Telegram.
- [CLI and commands](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/cli.md): Use terminal flags, slash commands, keyboard shortcuts and updates.
- [Files and paths](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/files-and-paths.md): Locate configuration, extension roots, state, logs and packaged documentation.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incadawr/anycode/master/docs/user/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose missing integrations, provider errors, engine startup and logs.
